senses.gloss:
Audumbararṣi
pupil of Nimbārka.
--Audumbarī Saṁhitā or Vratapañcakanirṇaya or Rāgavihiṁsanavratanirṇaya. IO. 2487.
--Nimbārkavikrānti. Rep. Hpr. 1901-6, p. 17.

Audumbarāyaṇa
philosopher of language q. by Yāska in his Nirukta (I. 1), an. ref. to by Bhartṛhari in Vākyapadīya II. 347. On his theory of language see BSOAS. XIV. p.. 73 ff.

Audumbarīsaṃhitā
also called vratapaJcakanirNaya an. rAgavihiMsanavratanirNaya vaiṣ. Nimbārka school. compiled chiefly from Purāṇas by Udumbara Ṛṣi, pupil of Nimbārka. AS. p. 34. IO. 2487. Oudh VIII. 26. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 37. Sūcīpattra 33.
